title: input / independent seats
invariant: Actual XI2 events reach the selected live surface in local coordinates without a root-coordinate atlas or cross-actor leakage.
objective: Implement the production behavior exercised by the exact listed assertions; preserve the phase invariant.
command_note: Set SPATIAL_SUT to the real JSON argv before these commands, or pass --sut with that same JSON argv. P04+ also requires the explicit dedicated test display.
steps: Read the named assertions and relevant normative contract sections.
Run the focused case and retain the failing evidence.
Implement the smallest production change; do not put product logic in the harness.
Run the focused cases and inspect independent evidence.
Run the unfiltered cumulative gate and inspect regressions.
Record commit, evidence and a representative mutation result before closing the phase.
helper_rule: After two failures on the same invariant, delegate a bounded diagnosis with exact evidence; Luna reviews and runs all tests.
forbidden_changes: locked acceptance/oracle/gate changes merely to pass
silent weakening or skipping of earlier gates
